messages:
zoe: heads-up i tried a compact pass for the Console overview: switched token `spacing.small-3` from 12px -> 8px and trimmed table row padding to match. on staging the primary button baseline on cards looks visually low, and multi toasts push into the card header on smaller cards. percy diff: https://percy.io/redwood/console/changes/9876

marc: can you paste the token diff? i want to be sure we didn't touch `spacing.small-2` which our compact tables rely on.

zoe: token diff:
```diff
- --spacing-small-3: 12px;
+ --spacing-small-3: 8px; /* compact */
- --table-row-vertical-padding: 10px;
+ --table-row-vertical-padding: 6px;
```
intended only for dashboard card chrome but it floated into lists.

eli: small change but noticed `.card-cta` uses `padding-block` which some browsers compute differently when line-height changes. that explains the visual baseline shift. quick CSS fix: `.card-cta { padding-block: var(--spacing-small-3); line-height: 20px; }` or better: use flexbox centering on the actions container.

tara: toast issue: we currently render toasts as siblings of the app shell with absolute top offsets. that breaks when card chrome is short. propose moving toasts into a fixed portal anchored to top-right and reserving a safe area for headers: `.toast-portal { position: fixed; top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--header-height) + 12px); right: 16px; }`

marc: top-right portal ok, but some pages have sticky search bars that change `--header-height`. portal should recompute on header resize and prefer a `resizeobserver` or listen to header mutation instead of polling.

zoe: accessibility: each toast currently gets `aria-live="polite"`. when three toasts fire we announce three messages in quick succession. propose a single live region in the portal with `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"` and only set the region text to the newest toast (visually-hidden). also add `aria-describedby` for persistent toasts.

eli: keyboard: ESC today closes modals but doesn't dismiss toasts. expected behavior: ESC dismisses ephemeral toasts when focus is not in a focus trap. add `if (!document.activeElement.closest('.focus-trap')) dismissToasts()` with a11y test.

tara: perf: avoid reading layout for each toast on stack updates. compute each toast's final y offset in JS on mount and set transform inline; use `will-change: transform` and rAF for initial placement. debounce stack recalcs on window resize.

marc: plan: 1) zoe revert global `spacing.small-3` to avoid breaking lists and instead add `token.spacing.compact-card` behind `feature.ui.denseCards`; 2) tara implement top-right toast portal with header-safe calc + RO to recompute; 3) eli add aria live region + ESC behavior and tests; 4) i'll open a QA checklist to re-run Percy and confirm table rows and button baseline. target: PRs tomorrow morning? :thumbsup:

zoe: on it  i'll open the revert and add the scoped token + flag. attaching staging screenshots in PR. thanks for the quick review.

design-bot: PR #4509 (compact spacing) assigned to zoe  status: needs review.

marc: once revert and portal land let's re-introduce the compact card token via the feature flag and run visual diffs across top 10 console pages. will also check disabled button contrast since smaller padding can make outline focus feel cramped.

zoe: noted — i'll add a11y checks for focus ring size and disabled contrast in the canary plan. thanks!
